updates.title: Immersive 8D Spatial Audio
updates.description: Experience true 360° 8d spatial audio. Tap the 8D button in the music for an immersive live-concert soundstage on your headphones.

updates.title: Darling AI Can Now Perform Actions
updates.description: Darling AI can now perform light-weight actions — controlling media playback, launching tools, and operating completely offline.

updates.title: Cinematic Theatre Mode in Videos
updates.description: Watch your movies and videos in Theatre Mode with enhanced visual focus, and immersive theatre feel audio.

updates.title: Improved performance
updates.description: increased performance in media scanning, and reduced battery consumption during playback.
